items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade imminent; team comfortable with offer to sit him
items.implication: No Week 5 production; targets free up in ARI offense
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining ARI WRs

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.implication: Eagles RB committee or handcuff elevated

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5 (ankle).
items.implication: Backup QB start; Ravens pass game shifts
items.opportunity: TE/WR targets up in non-Lamar offense

items.text: MHJ inactive/trade means Kendrick Bourne season; MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't factoring into Michael Wilson usage.
items.why: MHJ low production historically in ARI; targets open

items.text: Stefon Diggs listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.implication: WAS WR targets redistribute with Daniels back
items.opportunity: More volume for McLaurin if active and others

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring).
items.implication: PHI WR targets to remaining options

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 5.
Jeremiyah Love listed IN for Week 5; not on final injury report.
items.why: Cleared final report despite ankle maintenance
items.opportunity: Full workload possible after prior limited usage

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week after Week 4 usage criticism, despite ankle maintenance. Not on final IR.
items.why: Media/fan pressure on prior usage + cleared report; downside risk still accounted
items.implication: Startable RB with expanded snaps/carries vs DET

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume and RZ usage vs weak secondary, amplified by MHJ inactive.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; gobbles targets/points, nickname push, benefits from CIN WR injuries potential.
Long-term multi-risk on Malik Nabers (knee, shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy, boomer coaching); short-term still good but stacking concerns.
items.why: Sore knee + frustration over targets + QB/coaching stacking
items.implication: Monitor closely; ROS caution despite talent

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; high volume including red zone vs soft pass defense.
Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX (London) as QB15; rough stretch and banged-up line.
items.why: Recent form + OL issues + London game
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options
